name: Security Characteristics 1 Code
definition: Security characteristics of the communication link.

CETE.name: Cardholder End To End Encryption
CETE.definition: Encryption initiated by the cardholder to secure end-to-end communication channel.

CPTE.name: Cardholder Point To Point Encryption
CPTE.definition: Encryption initiated by the cardholder to secure point-to-point communication channel.

CENC.name: Channel Encryption
CENC.definition: Encryption used to secure the communication channel.

CMAC.name: Channel MAC
CMAC.definition: Usage of MAC to secure a communication channel

ETEE.name: End To End Encryption
ETEE.definition: Encryption used from one end to the other end of the communication channel.

METE.name: Merchant End To End Encryption
METE.definition: Encryption initiated by the merchant to secure end-to-end communication channel.

MPTE.name: Merchant Point To Point Encryption
MPTE.definition: Encryption initiated by the merchant to secure point-to-point communication channel.

PMAC.name: Passthrough MAC
PMAC.definition: MAC used in a pass-through communication mode

PKIE.name: PKI Encryption
PKIE.definition: Encryption using PKI to secure the communication channel.

PRAE.name: Private Algorithm Encryption
PRAE.definition: Encryption using a private algorithm to secure a communication channel.

APTE.name: Acquirer Point To Point Encryption
APTE.definition: Encryption initiated by the acquirer to secure point-to-point communication channel.

AETE.name: Acquirer End To End Encryption
AETE.definition: Encryption initiated by the acquirer to secure end-to-end communication channel.

OTHN.name: Other National
OTHN.definition: Other security characteristics defined at national level

OTHP.name: Other Private
OTHP.definition: Other security characteristics defined at private level
